meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把标题、数据或地图变成动态短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想做会动的标题、图表或地图,又不想学专业软件
copy.tagline_en: Turn headlines, data, or maps into short animated videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to bring titles, charts, or maps to life without learning pro software.

howto.what: 装上后,当你请它做一段短视频动效时,Claude会先评估是否属于运动图形,然后规划、制作并渲染一段通常10秒以内的动效短片(如文字动画、数字滚动、图表动效、logo动画等),输出MP4或透明背景视频,无需旁白或真人出镜。
howto.when: 当你要求制作一段简短的设计型动效视频(如文字动画、数字滚动、图表动效等),且通常10秒内、无旁白时触发。若内容更长、有旁白或多场景,则不会由它处理。

say.text: 把这句话做成动态文字短片,10秒内,无旁白。
say.note: 会生成一段文字动效视频。

say.text: 做一个数字从0到100的滚动动画,带进度环。
say.note: 生成统计数字动效,输出MP4。

say.text: 把这份销售数据做成柱状图动效,8秒。
say.note: 会渲染成图表动效视频。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask for a short motion graphic, Claude plans, builds, and renders a clip usually under 10 seconds (kinetic type, count-up, charts, logo sting, etc.), outputting MP4 or a transparent overlay, without narration or live action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a short design-led motion graphic (e.g. kinetic type, count-up, chart animation), usually under 10 seconds and without narration. Longer, narrated, or multi-scene requests go elsewhere.

say_en.text: Turn this quote into a kinetic-type video, under 10s, no narration.
Make a count-up animation from 0 to 100 with a progress ring.
say_en.note: Renders a stat motion graphic to MP4.

say_en.text: Turn this sales data into a bar chart animation, 8 seconds.
